description: Shut the street door, and offered the loaf.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Counted two candles, refused a third, and went down.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Stayed on the Chaucer. He was not moved.
name: Gib

description: Sat in his pew, and did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Gave the grace, and kept the house.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Named the fog, left the cat, and refused the loaf.
name: William Shakespeare
